newsitem.title: USA: Fila sees Q2 earnings below analysts' estimates.
newsitem.headline: Fila sees Q2 earnings below analysts' estimates.

text.p: Fila Holding S.p.A. said on Friday it expects earnings for the second quarter to be in the range of $0.53 per share and $0.60, which would fall below the First Call analysts' consensus estimate of $0.88 per share.
Fila said in a news release that its earnings would be affected primarily by general weakness in the U.S. footwear and apparel market, which led to increased order cancellations.
Also contributing to Fila's bottom-line problems were unexpected problems with its warehouse software system, which affected deliveries, the company said.

A "minor portion" of the difference between analysts' estimates and what the company will report is due to an acceleration of strategic investments aimed at strengthening FIla's product range, the company said.
Fila said it projects revenue growth for fiscal 1997 of 18 percent to 23 percent, in Italian lire.
Full results for the second quarter will be reported on July 31.
Fila makes athletic and casual footwear, and activewear, casualwear and sportwear.
